title: A Gepner stability condition on every smooth quintic threefold
main_claim: Every smooth complex quintic threefold X has a numerical Bridgeland stability condition (Z,P) with full support property such that, for Phi = T_{O_X} o (-⊗O_X(1)), Z(Phi E)=e^{2πi/5}Z(E), Phi P(φ)=P(φ+2/5), and Z(O_x)=-1. This resolves Toda's normalized quintic Gepner conjecture.

issues.description: The whole construction depends on an external, recent result: Xu 2026, Thm 1.3, a stronger BG-type inequality on the quintic. The paper only checks that Xu's bound g implies the weaker envelope f it needs. The essential input is f(1/2) = -3/100 < 1/4 - u ≈ -0.0264, which gives the margin m_b ≈ 0.0036. It cannot be checked from this paper alone.
issues.evidence: I checked the comparison g ≤ f on [0,1/2] piece by piece (it uses 5/13 < 25/62), the continuity of g, and that f satisfies h(1-x)=h(x)+1/2-x, which matches dualizing then twisting. The comparison is correct. The truth of Xu's theorem itself is assumed.
